questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The best bands to see live at summer festivals
Why concert tickets have become so expensive
How bands try to tour while harming the planet less
How to reduce your own carbon footprint at home
questions.why: Neil says they'll find out about bands who want to keep touring but reduce their environmental impact.

questions.q: What has Neil decided to do to help the environment?
options: Eat less meat and drive less
Stop flying completely
Buy an electric car
Stop going to concerts
questions.why: He says he's decided to eat less meat and maybe drive his car less.

questions.q: Why does Rob laugh about the name Green Day?
options: It sounds like a type of food
The band has broken up
The band doesn't care about the environment
It suits a band trying to be environmentally friendly
questions.why: He says, “what a good name for a band trying to be environmentally friendly!”

questions.q: What has drummer Fay Milton done this year?
options: Started a new band
Turned down a tour
Bought an electric bus
Toured only by train
questions.why: She says, “This year I have actually turned down a tour.”

questions.q: How does Fay Milton feel about her decision?
options: Worried and sorry she did it
Angry with other musicians
Good, even though it's risky for her income
Unsure if it was the right choice
questions.why: She says it's put her in a precarious situation but she feels quite good; it's the right thing to do.

questions.q: What concern does Rob raise about bands stopping touring altogether?
options: Musicians would get bored
Fans wouldn't get to see live concerts
Record companies would close
Ticket prices would rise
questions.why: Rob says if bands stopped touring, fans wouldn't get to see gigs.

questions.q: How does Massive Attack plan to travel around Europe?
options: By private jet, to save time between concerts
By electric car, driven by the band members
By ship, with the equipment in a separate van
Only by train, with all the crew and equipment
questions.why: Robert Del Naja says they plan to travel to Europe solely by train, with the band, crew and gear.

questions.q: What does Massive Attack hope to do with the power created by renewable energy?
options: Put it back into the grid to power future gigs
Sell it to fans cheaply to use in their homes
Use it to charge fans' phones during the gigs
Store it in big batteries on the tour bus
questions.why: He says the power will go back to the grid, creating green infrastructure to power future gigs.
